description.value: Ramada Limited Merritt is a mid-scale Wyndham-branded hotel located on Voght Street in Merritt, a highway town at the junction of the Coquihalla and the Okanagan connector routes. As part of the Ramada Limited tier, it is a straightforward lodging option for travellers passing through the Thompson-Nicola region. Touring cyclists riding the interior plateau routes will find it a conveniently situated overnight stop in an otherwise spread-out town.

No evidence for bike storage, laundry, breakfast, or any other cyclist amenities is present in either source.
